methods.name: Mixed logit (random parameters logit) with mlogit's Halton draw scheme, cross-section and panel
methods.reference: mlogit::mlogit(rpar = c(x = 'n'), R = 50, halton = NA[, panel = TRUE]): simulated log-likelihood re-solved with optim(BFGS, reltol = 1e-15) and numDeriv Newton steps; SEs from numDeriv::hessian; mlogit:::halton
quantities: simulated log-likelihood and gradient at fixed points (normal; log-normal + normal)
conditional logit as the no-random special case
MCP and CLI text at print precision, CLI JSON at full tolerance
methods.tolerance: iterative MLE: means and SD 1e-6 relative, SEs 1e-5, log-likelihood validation/README.md stat(300) = 1e-6; mlogit's own estimate cross-checked at 1e-4 (its SEs are BHHH-style: recorded as se_pkg, not pinned); likelihood at fixed points 1e-11, analytic vs numDeriv gradient 1e-7 (abs 1e-8); Halton points exact, normal quantiles 1e-13 (statrs vs AS241); text Tol::printed(4)
